impact.title: Analysis of Unified Plans and Reports
impact.lead: How the Unified Planning and Reporting process is growing across the IFRC network — rising participation, funding ambition, people reached, and partners engaged.

visuals.title: Participation (coverage)
visuals.hint: National Societies completing a plan or report each year (reports: annual, or mid-year where the annual is not yet available).

visuals.title: Funding ambition & delivery
visuals.hint: Same mix as the Financial Overview network, CHF. Planned requirement is the country plan (host National Society + IFRC Secretariat + PNS lines on the plan). Reported funding adds PNS self-reports, other sources, and IFRC Secretariat actuals. Reported expenditure adds PNS self-reports and IFRC Secretariat actuals.

table.title: Funding ambition & delivery
table.note: Same mix as the Financial Overview network block. Planned requirement is the country plan: host National Society + IFRC Secretariat + PNS lines recorded on that plan. Reported funding is PNS self-reported funding + other sources on the country report + IFRC Secretariat actuals (2025 and 2026 snapshots; earlier years have none). Reported expenditure is PNS self-reported expenditure + those IFRC actuals. Host National Society strategic-priority totals are not added on top. Transfers are not counted as expenditure.
table.legend: Mid-year report, shown where the annual report is not yet available

visuals.title: People to be reached
visuals.hint: People the network plans to reach, by plan year.

visuals.title: Partners engaged
visuals.hint: Participating National Societies providing bilateral support, and the funding they self-report (PNS data, CHF).

table.title: Partners engaged
table.note: Source: Participating National Society self-reports (PNS data). This is separate from the PNS amount a host National Society records in its own plan. Under a country, the partner count is the societies supporting that country; the year total counts each society once.

visuals.title: National Society capacity
visuals.hint: Volunteers, staff, branches and local units reported by host National Societies.

notes: * Year still open (2025) — submissions are still coming in, so the latest point understates the final total. Headline figures use the latest completed year.
Reporting figures use the annual report where available, otherwise the mid-year report (years: 2025).
Indicative network totals summed from Unified Plans and Reports currently in the database. The trend spans the rounds that have submissions; it is not a historical back-fill.

ALL.title: Participation: data and narrative
ALL.lead: A National Society takes part in a round when it submits its data form or hands in its narrative. The internal narrative is the document sent to the Secretariat (IFRC GO, internal); the public narrative is the one published on the public site. Counting data alone misses countries that only take part through the narrative.

visuals.title: Participation by stage
visuals.hint: National Societies in each round at each stage. “Either” is the real participation: data submitted or internal narrative handed in.

visuals.title: How countries take part
visuals.hint: Both data and narrative, narrative only, or data only. Blank where the databank holds no data for that round.

visuals.title: From internal to public
visuals.hint: Internal narratives received, and how many of those countries have a public document.

visuals.title: How consistently countries take part
visuals.hint: National Societies by the number of completed rounds (plans, mid-year and annual reports) they took part in. Rounds still open or only partly covered by the sources are left out.
